title: Enhanced Due Diligence Evidence Record
description: Records the source, provenance, status and limitations of evidence linked to a specific claim in an EDD review.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for the evidence record.

claim_reference.description: Identifier of the specific claim this evidence record relates to. The claim should be documented separately in the EDD case findings.

title.description: Title of the source or a clearly labelled placeholder if unavailable.

publisher.description: Publisher, author or issuing organization, if known.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL with a non-empty authority/host, if available. A structurally valid URL is not proof that the resource exists.

reference.description: Document identifier or other traceable reference, if available.

publication_date.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null if unknown.

access_date.description: Date the source was actually accessed or checked, or null if it was not accessed.

source_classification.description: One or more applicable classifications. These categories may overlap.

jurisdiction.description: Relevant country, territory or legal jurisdiction, if known.

excerpt_or_summary.description: Relevant excerpt or neutral summary. Do not invent quotations or attribute unsupported claims to a source.

provenance_notes.description: Explains how the source was obtained, what was checked and any known provenance limitations.

limitations.description: Known gaps, uncertainty and verification limitations. Use an empty array if none are identified.
